write_graph guidance BEFORE the 2026-09-26 handbook split: count<TAB>word.

The mechanical proof that relocating the long-form chapters out of the
advertised description lost nothing. Generated from origin/main
tinyassets/engine_mcp_server.py at 51907327 -- the commit before the split --
by Counter(write_graph.__doc__.split()).

tests/test_served_tool_guidance.py asserts every word below still occurs at
least this often across the resident description plus every chapter, so a
later edit cannot delete guidance quietly. Relocation and rewording are
allowed; deletion is not.

Format: a data line is count, one TAB, then the word. A word from .split()
can never contain a tab, so any line WITHOUT a tab is this comment header --
which matters because the guidance itself contains words starting with #.
Regenerate ONLY if the baseline commit changes, and say so in the PR.
